title: Merge Toolbar Into Footer
description: Move the floating toolbar-anchor overlay into the footer bar so that the toolbar content renders inline inside the footer instead of floating above it.
summary: Merged toolbar into footer: FooterProps/Footer gained a toolbar prop that renders the toolbar content as an absolute centered overlay within the footer bar (pointer-events: none on the anchor, auto on children). LayoutProps/Layout lost its toolbar prop — the separate toolbar-anchor floating above the footer was removed. UiProps/Ui likewise dropped its toolbar prop. The renderer's ProductShell now passes toolbar={slotToolbar} to Footer instead of Layout. CSS: [data-slot=toolbar-anchor] changed from floating above footer to centered within footer; removed --toolbar-footer-offset CSS variable and its test assertion.
